picks.title: How Agents 404's Devs Prototyped With AI and Gained 120K Wishlists in Two Months
picks.excerpt: PlayHero founder Anton Slashcev explains how the AI tool Bezi helped his team prototype Agents 404 in one month, why core systems stayed hand-authored, and where human technical expertise is still essential.
picks.rationale: A rare concrete before/after on AI-assisted prototyping — what the tool did, what the team refused to hand over, and a measurable market result a small studio can copy this week.

picks.title: No Man's Sky Fan Adds DLSS 5 — Hello Games Programmer Worries It Could Ruin Its Look and Feel
picks.excerpt: A modder pushed Nvidia's DLSS 5 AI filter into No Man's Sky, prompting a Hello Games programmer to warn the generative layer could erase the game's deliberately stylised look.
picks.rationale: The single strongest DLSS 5 item in the pool: a working developer stating exactly how a runtime generative pass overrides authored art direction, outside the studio's control.

picks.title: ByteBrew Brings Live Operations Into App Developers' AI Workflows
picks.excerpt: ByteBrew is folding live-ops into agentic AI workflows, aiming to close the loop from player-behaviour insight to in-game action without manual handoffs.
picks.rationale: Moves the AI argument off art and onto design authorship — live-ops agents start making balance and content calls that used to sit with a designer.

picks.title: Video Game Companies Keep Trying To Bait And Switch Us With AI
picks.excerpt: 1666: Amsterdam, Blood of Dawnwalker and others claim AI assets didn't make the final game — but that doesn't mean the projects were AI-free.
picks.rationale: Names the emerging disclosure-language pattern across four titles, so studio leads can see how 'no AI in the shipped build' reads to an audience before they write it.

picks.title: Steam Week in Review: A Touch of AI Is All It Takes to Trigger Backlash
picks.excerpt: A promising new indie fell afoul of 'slop skeptics' on Steam, showing how little AI-touched asset work it now takes to derail a launch's reception.
picks.rationale: Practical risk calibration for anyone shipping AI-assisted art: the audience penalty triggers on trace amounts, not on scale of use.
